_comment: Hand-curated overlay of well-documented, individually-sourced avian influenza events (human cases and a few notable animal anchors) from official bulletins (WHO / CDC / WOAH). These change slowly and are merged into every run so the global view keeps verified anchor points. Australian animal detections are normally left to the automated FAO EMPRES-i feed (see pipeline/sources/fao-empresi.mjs), because that feed carries them without hand work. The exception is a nationally significant first, such as a state's first detection: EMPRES-i ingests WOAH/WAHIS notifications and was measured on 30 July 2026 running about 14 days behind Australian announcements, so such an event may be curated here to cover the lag. The reconciliation step (pipeline/lib/reconcile.mjs) drops the curated copy once the automated feed carries the same event, so nothing is double-counted. Human cases are curated because EMPRES-i's human data is unreliable. Counts left null where no authoritative machine-readable figure exists. Dates are the reported/confirmation date. 'confidence' is 'presumptive' when an authority has announced a detection but confirmatory sequencing is still outstanding; Australian official tallies themselves count 'confirmed or presumed positive' events together, so this mirrors official practice rather than hedging.
